tokens._doc: The Second Take's motion-engine style tokens — data the niche-agnostic Remotion engine reads. Character/palette law: style-bible.md; this file only styles ENGINE-drawn elements (captions, device cards, camera feel). Values marked (measured) come from the 2026-07-08 motion teardown — see research/motion-logs/ + universal.md §13a-iii.
tokens.font_family: 'Ink Free', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', Arial, sans-serif
tokens._font_note: LOCKED Ink Free (user-picked 2026-07-08 from the engine-frame auditions). Styles ENGINE-drawn text only (device cards, overlays, shorts captions); in-image diegetic lettering is style-bible territory. Teardown type law: one handwritten-marker family.

caption._enabled_note: (measured) reference grade burns ZERO word-captions in 16:9 — text is diegetic or a card; shorts keep captions (platform norm). Flip to true to reverse.

idle._note: OFF (user-directed 2026-07-10): fully-locked look. The camera is furniture AND frames hold dead-still; life comes from hard cuts + element/overlay animations + the rare motivated push (gravity/escalation). Set bob_px/breathe_scale back to 5/0.005 to restore the float.

camera._note: Camera is ALWAYS LOCKED (build_motion.py::locked_camera): no move is derived. These scale/whip/pan dials remain only for the engine spring if a future explicit/authored move is ever added (§13a-iii.1).

type_on._note: (measured) text always animates on at speech pace and lands on its spoken word (§13a-iii.3)

entrance._note: (measured) pop/snap 0.3–0.5s spring settle > type-on > slide ~0.5s ease-out no overshoot; fades near-banned (§13a-iii.2)
